clips.text: Mrs. Victor Murdock, wife of for mer Representative, Murdock, and Miss Katherine Murdock have come from their home in Wichita, Kans., and are spending some time at the Wardman Park Hotel.

Dr. Jorge E. Boyd, formerly secre tary and counselor of the Panama legation and attorney general of the Republic of Panama, arrived recentlv at the Wardman Park Hotel and joined Mrs. Boyd and her children, where they will pass a few’ months.
… returned from a. six weeks' tour through the United States, going as far as the Pacific Coast and stopping at atl the great industrial renters, and is at the Wardman Park Hotel.
Successful men and progressive women guard their health and keep fit through exercise. Wardman Park Health Club (swim ming pool ssetion); 2 lessens per week. $6 per month.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
